the monitor is read at the base's traces, moved by +2.44 ms and scaled by 1.30, both measured over 600-1400 where nothing in the earth should have changed (median lag of 431 trace pairs; a constant offset between two processings is not a change in the earth)
the grain: after those corrections the two vintages still differ by an NRMS of 0.34 (correlation 0.94) in that window; a difference deeper down must be read against it
